picked.body: (사진=호치민시 공안) 베트남 호치민시에서 출입국 및 체류 규정을 위반한 한국인 6명이 현지 공안 당국에 의해 추방됐다. 호치민시 고법동(phuong Go Vap) 공안 당국자는 “지역 경찰은 시 출입국관리국과 떤선녓(Tan Son Nhat) 국제공항 출입국 경찰 및 관계 기관 간 협조를 통해 전날인 9일 한국인 6명을 추방했다”고 10일 밝혔다. 이날 추방된 한국인 6명은 공안 당국이 해당 지역에 거주·활동 중인 외국인 단속 과정에서 적발된 것으로 전해졌다. 당국에 따르면, 경찰은 이들 한국인 6명이 첨단기술 범죄에 연루되었을 가능성을 포착한 뒤, 이들이 임차 중이던 지역 내 한 아파트에서 일당을 모두 붙잡았다. 경찰은 숙소 수색 과정에서 범죄에 사용되었을 것으로 추정되는 컴퓨터와 스마트폰, 태블릿, 노트북 등 다수의 전자기기를 발견했다. 출입국관리국 확인 결과, 이들 전원은 임시거주신고를 하지 않은 상태였으며, 경찰은 시 공안국 전문 부서의 추가 조사를 통해 이들이 전자비자(e-비자)를 발급받아 입국한 뒤, 허용된 체류 기간을 넘겨 불법 체류 중인 사실까지 밝혀냈다. 공안 관계자들에 따르면, 이들 한국인 6명은 경찰 적발 당시, 여권을 제시하지 않는 등 현지 경찰의 단속에 비협조적인 자세를 보인 것으로 전해졌다. 시 공안국은 과태료와 추방 등 베트남 법률에 따라 허가 없이 베트남에 입국해 직업 활동이나 기타 활동을 한 행위에 대한 행정 제재를 처분했다. 지역 경찰 관계자는 “베트남 법을 위반하는 외국인들은 종종 소규모 그룹으로 활동하며 단속 기관의 적발을 피하기 위해 거처를 자주 옮기는 경향을 보인다”고 설명했다. 한편, 같은 날 중부 다낭시 공안국 또한 전자비자를 통해 입국한 뒤, 비자 발급 목적 외 영리 활동을 한 중국인 4명을 붙잡아 다낭국제공항을 통해 추방했다고 밝혔다. 이날 추방된 중국인들 역시 지역 내 거주·활동 외국인 단속에서 적발됐는데, 이들은 베트남 체류 기간 경품을 제공하는 태국 게임앱의 온라인 고객서비스 업무를 맡았던 것으로 드러났다. 이들에게는 추방과 함께 1인당 2,250만 동씩의 과태료가 부과된 것으로 전해졌다. 이에 대해 한 지역 전문가는 “공안 당국의 이번 단속은 외국인에 대한 관리 강화와 동시에 치안·공공질서를 유지하는 목적과 함께 베트남 출입국 관련 법률이 엄격히 집행되고 있음을 보여주는 것”이라고 설명했다.

picked.t: Vietnamese workers spend 4.5 months of wages to secure jobs abroad
picked.body: Costs have fallen 23.8% from VND164.9 million ($6,340) in 2021, according to analysis released Sept. 8 by the National Statistics Office with technical support from the International Organization for Migration. Average first-month income abroad rose 25.4% over the same period, from VND22.4 million ($860) to VND28.1 million ($1,080). Nguyen Thi Ngoc Lan of the office's Population and Labor Statistics Division said a first month's wage abroad runs 3.3 times the average income of a worker at home, which is VND8.5 million ($327). Payments to recruitment companies and individual brokers take 52.8% of what a worker spends, an average of VND94.5 million ($3,635) among those who paid them. Training and document preparation account for 33.7%, travel 11.1% and other expenses 2.3%. Three markets: Japan, South Korea and Taiwan, which together take 76.7% of Vietnamese workers going abroad, carry the highest costs. Workers heading to Japan paid an average of VND140.8 million ($5,415) in 2025, those going to South Korea VND139.4 million ($5,360) and those to Taiwan VND130.2 million ($5,010). Other destinations averaged nearly VND86 million ($3,310). Lan said costs climb as education levels fall, with one group paying as much as VND155.6 million ($5,985). By skill level, medium-skilled workers paid around VND143 million ($5,500), low-skilled workers VND109 million ($4,190) and high-skilled workers just under VND68 million ($2,615). Workers typically spend about six months preparing before departure, and around seven months for those bound for Japan and South Korea. Some 53.9% of those surveyed borrowed to cover the fees. The statistics office cautioned that this part of the study, which drew on 3,596 migrant workers across six provinces and cities, used non-probability sampling and does not represent all Vietnamese workers abroad. Elementary occupations account for 33% of Vietnamese working abroad, craft and related trades about 24%, and machine and equipment operation 16%. Workers with a college diploma or higher earn an average of VND42.6 million ($1,640) in their first month, those with elementary or intermediate vocational training VND27.6 million ($1,060), high school graduates VND26 million ($1,000) and lower secondary graduates about VND22 million ($845). Costs have fallen from previous years but remain high, Lan said, given that most workers going abroad come from rural areas and more than half must borrow. She said regulators need to keep pushing costs down, make fees transparent and control informal charges, while raising workers' skill levels and helping them find work when they return. Nguyen Hai Ly, deputy head of the legal affairs division at the Department of Overseas Labor under the Ministry of Home Affairs, said recruitment and brokerage fees still make up a large share of what workers pay, with most of the excess arising from informal intermediaries who operate before a worker reaches a licensed company. He credited the decline in costs to the 2020 Law on Vietnamese Guest Workers. It abolished brokerage fees charged to workers and shifted them onto companies, and capped service fees at one month's salary for each year of a contract. An amendment to that law, passed by the National Assembly on Aug. 24 and taking effect March 1, 2027, further tightens the ceiling on charges collected outside service fees and stiffens penalties for companies that break the rules. It also caps the wait between selection and departure at 180 days, obliging companies that miss the deadline to compensate workers and refund what they paid. The Department of Overseas Labor said it will use bilateral negotiations to push foreign partners and employers to share recruitment costs, airfares and training, moving step by step toward a model in which workers pay no recruitment fees at all. Data on returning workers will also be integrated into the employment services system to connect them with employers, particularly foreign-invested firms from the markets where those workers were previously posted.

picked.t: Southeast Asian country granted visa on arrival to Egypt
picked.body: This decision reflected Egypt's commitment to promoting tourism exchanges and people-to-people ties with Vietnam, Saleh said, highly valuing growing interest from the business communities of both countries in investment and tourism opportunities. The official highlighted tourism as an important area contributing to the development of Vietnam-Egypt relations, expressing his hope that the visa facilitation will further increase tourist flows between the two countries and create greater opportunities for exchanges and cooperation. Egypt announced in May that citizens of certain countries would be eligible for visas on arrival as part of efforts to boost its tourism industry. The minister's direct confirmation that Vietnamese citizens are included in the scheme is particularly significant for Vietnamese travelers planning to visit Egypt. Egypt is a major tourist destination in North Africa, home to renowned attractions including the Giza Pyramids, the Sphinx and Cairo, as well as numerous historical and cultural heritage sites. The number of Vietnamese visitors to Egypt has grown in recent years, contributing to stronger people-to-people ties and tourism cooperation between the two countries.

picked.t: What business leaders invest in to stay ahead
picked.body: More than 20 years after leaving university, Nguyen Xuan Hop, Global Procurement Director at Target, one of the largest retail groups in the U.S., returned to education to pursue a Master of Business Administration at British University Vietnam (BUV). For an experienced business leader who travels internationally, the decision required balancing nearly two years of study with professional responsibilities, family commitments, travel, tuition costs, and time away from work. It is a calculation shared by many mid-career professionals. According to NielsenIQ, while middle managers seek advancement into senior leadership, they also increasingly consider the return on investment (ROI) of postgraduate education. Foundation for long-term returns Postgraduate education is increasingly assessed not only by the qualification itself but also by the professional and financial value it can generate. Even amid economic uncertainty, multinational companies including Deloitte, PwC, and Unilever continue to fund master's degrees for selected employees to strengthen leadership, strategic thinking, and risk management capabilities. For individuals, the potential return extends beyond salary growth to include stronger management skills and professional networks. Financial return is one of the most measurable factors. The Financial Times includes "Value for Money" among its MBA ranking criteria, comparing graduates' earnings three years after completion with the cost of tuition and opportunity costs. Its 2026 data show that graduates from 100 MBA programs recorded salary increases of up to 200-250% within three years of graduation. Financial returns, however, are only part of the equation. As businesses become more complex, analytical thinking, leadership, and decision-making are increasingly important to career progression. The World Economic Forum's Future of Jobs Report 2025 identifies analytical thinking and leadership among key skills employers value. Graduate business programs can help professionals develop these capabilities through academic study and practical problem-solving. GMAC research in 2026 found that roughly two-thirds of global employers agreed that leaders in their organizations tend to hold graduate business degrees. Professional networks provide another potential return. Postgraduate programs bring together professionals from different industries and generations, allowing participants to exchange perspectives and build relationships beyond their existing circles. GMAC research involving more than 12,000 graduates from over 230 postgraduate programs found that relationships with classmates and industry professionals can contribute to career development. Together, these factors mean the value of postgraduate education can extend beyond the degree itself, combining knowledge, management capabilities, and professional relationships that remain relevant as business conditions change. Shortening the path to return on investment Once education is viewed as an investment, professionals must also consider how to maximize its value while managing time and financial commitments. This is reflected in the design of BUV's MSc International Business Management (MIBM) program. MIBM graduates receive dual degrees from BUV, ranked among Asia's top 43 MBA providers in the QS 2026 rankings, and Manchester Metropolitan University, whose Business School holds Triple Crown accreditation. For professionals seeking an international qualification, studying overseas can involve substantial tuition, living expenses, and time away from work and family. According to BUV, completing a master's degree in the U.K. can cost VND1.5 billion (US$57,180) to VND2 billion in total. BUV's MIBM, by comparison, is delivered in Vietnam over 12 months, allowing participants to continue their professional and personal commitments while studying. The program also connects students with business leaders and experts through BUV's network of more than 500 corporate partners. For Hop, practical application was an important part of the experience. "My time studying for an MBA at BUV fully met my expectations. It broadened my strategic perspective and allowed me to apply what I learned directly to my work at Target, from financial analysis and operational decision-making to business planning and supply chain optimization," he said. He also said interactions with professionals from different generations and industries helped him keep pace with developments in artificial intelligence and innovation while gaining broader perspectives on working in an increasingly international business environment. The MIBM program also includes international study opportunities and consulting projects in which students work on business challenges and apply academic knowledge in practice. picked.t: Ho Chi Minh City shuts its biggest underpass over flooding, backing traffic up 2 km
picked.body: Vehicles pile up around the An Phu interchange after the underpass flooded following overnight rain, forcing authorities to close it and deal with the incident. It is the second time the underpass has flooded since it opened to traffic in February 2026. The underpass is about 14 m wide with four lanes, letting vehicles run straight between Mai Chi Tho-Dong Van Cong and the Thu Thiem Tunnel without crossing surface traffic. An Phu is Ho Chi Minh City's largest interchange, connecting the Ho Chi Minh City-Long Thanh-Dau Giay Expressway with the Mai Chi Tho, Luong Dinh Cua, Nguyen Thi Dinh and Dong Van Cong arterials. Flooding inside the underpass stretched roughly 300 m. The Area 2 firefighting police team deployed several specialized vehicles and pumps to drain the water, while the Ho Chi Minh City Urban Drainage Company sent a sludge suction truck to help. With the underpass closed, traffic was funneled onto the roundabout, creating a backup of more than 2 km. The prolonged jam left many drivers stepping out of their vehicles onto the road after waiting too long. Thanh Trung, 60, hauling cargo from Dong Nai to Binh Chanh, said he had been stuck at the An Phu roundabout for about 45 minutes without moving. "Every other day I get through the underpass very quickly. Today the road is closed, and it's been stop-and-go all morning, inching forward, sometimes sitting completely still and wasting time," he said. Many drivers rolled down their windows and passed the time on their phones while waiting for the traffic to ease. Vehicles packed tight at the An Phu roundabout. The road surface was still flooded on Friday morning, forcing drivers to pick out the higher stretches of pavement to keep water out of their engines. A representative of the Ho Chi Minh City Transport Construction Investment Project Management Board said the underpass flooded because the volume of water exceeded the pumps' capacity.

포드의 픽업트럭 레인저. (사진=포드베트남) 미국 자동차 제조사 포드가 에어백 결함으로 베트남 내 운행 중인 레인저 700대를 리콜한다. 베트남 공상부 산하 국가경쟁위원회(NCC)는 최근 포드레인저의 에어백 브라켓 점검·교체 리콜 프로그램을 발표했다. NCC는 “포드베트남으로부터 국내 시장에 수입·유통된 2026~2027년형 포드레인저의 B필러 에어백 브라켓 점검·교체 리콜 계획에 관한 보고서를 접수했다”고 밝혔다. 리콜 대상 차량은 지난 4월 20일부터 6월 22일 사이 생산된 더블캡 픽업트럭으로, 베트남 내 리콜 대수는 총 683대다. 부품 교체는 무상으로, 작업에는 약 2시간이 소요된다. NCC는 이번 리콜 대상 차종 683대가 앞서 포드베트남이 지난달 말 발표한 레인저 리콜 대수 1,514대에 포함되는지에 대해서는 별도로 밝히지 않았다. 한편, NCC는 포드와 아우디, BMW, 포르쉐 등 해외에서 발표된 여러 브랜드의 차량 리콜 사례를 파악하고 있다. 유럽연합(EU)의 위험 비식품 신속경보시스템인 세이프티게이트(Safety Gate)에 따르면, 아우디·BMW·포르쉐·포드의 여러 차종이 형식승인·시장감시 요건을 충족하지 못한 것으로 확인돼 최종 소비자 대상 리콜 조치를 받았다. 주요 리콜 차종으로는 작년 10월 15일부터 지난 6월 5일 사이 독일에서 생산된 아우디 Q3이 포함됐다. 해당 모델은 앞좌석 안전벨트 프리텐셔너의 가스발생장치 용접부에 결함이 있을 수 있으며, 충돌 사고 발생 시 부품 이탈로 탑승자가 부상 당할 위험이 있다. 또한 작년 11월 25일부터 지난 5월 4일 사이 독일에서 생산된 전기차 BMW iX3는 충전 기능에 사용되는 전자모듈이 생산 과정에서 결함이 있을 수 있다. 이로 인해 충전 중 차체로 전류가 흐를 수 있으며, 사용자가 고전압 감전 위험에 노출될 수 있다. 포르쉐의 경우, 2019년 10월 21일부터 2024년 3월 4일 사이 독일에서 생산된 타이칸이 고전압 배터리 모듈에 여러 복합적인 제조 결함 가능성으로 리콜된다. 이러한 결함은 차량 운행 중 화재 발생 위험을 높일 수 있다. 포드는 트랜짓커스텀 및 투르네오커스텀이 안전 경고 대상에 포함됐다. 두 차종의 제조국은 튀르키예로, 제조일은 트랜짓커스텀이 2023년 5월 16일부터 2025년 9월 12일, 투르네오커스텀이 2025년 11월 25일부터 올해 3월 4일까지다. 이들 모델 역시 앞좌석 안전벨트 프리텐셔너의 가스발생장치 용접부에 결함이 있을 수 있다.

picked.t: 베트남, 부동산시행社 분양 시 대금결제 계좌이체 의무화…위반 시 과태료 최대 3억 동
picked.body: 베트남 호치민시의 한 아파트 단지. 베트남에서 부동산 프로젝트 계약대금을 현금으로 받는 시행사는 앞으로 최대 3억 동(1만1,582달러)의 과태료를 부과받게 된다. 베트남 정부는 최근 이러한 내용을 담은 부동산 관리·영업 분야의 행정 제재 기준을 구체적으로 규정한 시행령 제339/2026/ND-CP호를 공포했다. 이번 시행령은 지난달 26일부터 적용되고 있다. 본 시행령 제66조에 따르면, △프로젝트 시행사 △부동산업체 △부동산 서비스업체는 구매자로부터 은행을 통한 송금이 아닌 다른 방식으로 계약대금을 수령할 경우 2억4,000만~3억 동(9,266~1만1,582달러)의 과태료가 부과된다. 해당 규정은 부동산 매매 및 서비스 이용 시, 은행 계좌이체로 대금 지급을 의무화한 2023년 부동산사업법을 보다 구체화한 것이다. 다만, 소규모 부동산의 개인 영업이나, 주택 및 토지 매도 또는 임대인은 이전과 같이 현금 거래가 허용된다. 또한 제77조에는 자금세탁방지 관련 제재도 추가됐다. 해당 규정에 따르면, 부동산서비스업을 영위하는 조직·개인이 의심 거래 또는 고액 거래를 신고하지 않거나 부정확한 정보·서류를 제공하면 4,000만~8,000만 동(1,544~3,089달러)의 과태료가 되며, 영업정지 1~3개월이 뒤따를 수 있다. 현지 부동산 전문가들은 해당 규정이 부동산 시장에서의 자금 흐름에 대한 투명성을 높이고, 관계 기관의 통제력을 강화해 자금세탁을 방지할 수 있는 해법임과 동시에 다운 계약을 위한 이중 계약서 작성이나 계약 외 대금 수취, 수익 은닉 등의 관행을 억제하는 데 도움이 될 수 있다고 봤다. 시행령 제339호는 또 법인·조합·협동조합연합을 설립하지 않고 부동산영업을 한 행위에 대한 과태료도 1억2,000만~1억6,000만 동(4,633~6,177달러)으로 인상했다(기존 규정은 1억~1억2,000만 동). 이 과태료는 주택·건축물을 매입·임차·리스구매한 뒤 규정과 다르게 사용한 조직·개인에게도 동일하게 적용된다. 부가처분으로는 부동산영업 정지 3~6개월이 적용된다. 이 밖에도 이번 시행령에서는 법인이나 협동조합, 협동조합연합체 설립 없이 부동산 영업을 한 행위에 대한 과태료도 1억2,000만~1억6,000만 동으로 상향 조정했다. 기존 규정과 비교하면 2,000만~4,000만 동 인상된 것으로, 추가적인 제재로 영업정지 3~6개월이 뒤따를 수 있다. 해당 과태료는 주택 및 건축물 구매 또는 임대, 리스구매 규정을 위반한 개인·조직에 모두 적용된다. 또한 분양 전 프로젝트·상품 정보를 공개하지 않거나 불투명하게 공개한 시행사는 3억~4억 동의 과태료를 부과받을 수 있다. 이는 기존 규정보다 3배 넘게 인상된 것이다.

picked.t: Cake receives Euromoney's Vietnam Best Digital Bank 2026 award
picked.body: The award is part of Euromoney's Group Level Banking Awards, which assess banks on strategy, technology, business performance and customer value rather than individual products or applications. According to Euromoney, Cake has moved "from digital experimentation to scaled, profitable digital banking," using cloud and artificial intelligence (AI) as core components from the outset rather than adapting legacy banking systems. The shift highlights how technology and AI in digital banking need to create tangible value for both customers and business performance. After nearly six years of operation, Cake has now served more than 7.6 million customers through a digital platform covering payments, savings, credit, cards, investments and international money transfers. Its partner ecosystem spans retail, telecommunications, transportation, insurance and digital services. AI and data science are used to analyze customer needs and behaviors, and tailor services to individuals, with a digital-only infrastructure designed to support personalization as the customer base grows beyond 7.6 million. Cake said it became the first fully digital bank in Vietnam to announce profitability after 3.5 years of operation. Its average revenue per user (ARPU) reached US$25 in 2025 and is projected to rise to US$44 in 2026. Nguyen Huu Quang, CEO of Cake Digital Bank, represented the company at the awards ceremony. "The 'Vietnam's Best Digital Bank 2026' award from Euromoney marks a new stage in Cake's development," Quang said. "Through digital financial services, Cake is not only making financial services faster and more accessible to people but has also successfully built a scalable, fully digital bank capable of delivering personalization at scale and generating tangible business results. This provides a foundation for Cake to further develop its Next Gen AI Bank model in Vietnam and across the region." Established as a fully digital banking model in 2021, Cake is now focusing on customer engagement and financial performance alongside customer growth. Euromoney highlighted its transition to a digital banking model operating at scale and generating profits. The Euromoney Awards for Excellence has recognized banks and financial institutions worldwide for more than 30 years. Its evaluation system includes more than 700 banks across over 125 countries and territories. This year, Euromoney recognized leading banks globally and across the region, including Santander, Revolut, HSBC, DBS and Maybank. The 2026 awards ceremony was held in Singapore on Sept. 10.

picked.t: Fake Nike and Adidas shoes shipped from Vietnam tourist town to Russia
picked.body: She filed a complaint with Khanh Hoa Province's public feedback portal, alleging that a store called Sport Market was selling shoes bearing counterfeit Nike and Adidas branding. The store sits at 3 Tran Quang Khai Street, in the backpacker district of the beach city. Nha Trang draws more foreign visitors from Russia than from anywhere else in Vietnam. Khanh Hoa took in more than 734,700 Russian arrivals in the first seven months of 2026, more than triple the same period a year earlier, according to the provincial Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism. The woman said she went to the store after seeing it promoted by well-known bloggers and influencers in Nha Trang, and paid cash for two pairs, one Nike and one Adidas, to send to her boyfriend. A store employee told her the shoes were authentic. After they reached Russia, someone with relevant expertise examined them and determined both pairs were fake. The woman contacted the store to complain, but said it refused to accept a return or issue a refund because she had no receipt. After receiving the complaint, the Khanh Hoa Department of Industry and Trade directed Market Surveillance Team No. 1 to inspect the premises. Officers found the household business was selling goods that appeared to counterfeit trademarks protected in Vietnam. The team announced on Sept. 5 that it had fined the business VND50 million (US$1,900) for trading in trademark-counterfeit goods. It also ordered 180 pairs of shoes carrying fake Nike and Adidas branding to be destroyed. A representative of the store acknowledged that the two pairs sold to the woman were not authentic Nike or Adidas products, saying genuine shoes could not be had at VND1.3 million for two pairs. The employee who described the shoes as authentic was new, the representative said, adding that the store has always told customers its stock consists of "grade 1, 2 and 3" goods rather than genuine merchandise. "At VND500,000 to VND600,000 ($19 to $23) a pair, there is no way they are real. We have been trying to find her to apologize and refund both pairs, but we still have not reached her," the representative said. The store also acknowledged that it had sold goods counterfeiting protected brands before, had been penalized for it, and was considering shutting down. The representative denied paying influencers to promote the products. "The bloggers and influencers are mostly tourists. They come to shop and film on their own," the person said.

picked.t: 베트남 다낭, ‘아시아 재방문객 최선호 여행지’ 6위 올라…아고다
picked.body: 베트남 중부 해안관광도시 다낭의 관광 명소 중 하나인 골든브리지. (사진=SG) 베트남 중부 해안관광지인 다낭이 아고다가 꼽은 아시아 재방문 여행지 상위권에 이름을 올렸다. 온라인 여행 플랫폼 아고다가 올해 상반기 자사 플랫폼 숙소예약 데이터를 종합해 발표한 순위에 따르면, 베트남은 재방문율이 높은 아시아 여행지 상위 3개국을 유지했다. 아고다는 “재방문율은 여행지의 지속적인 매력도를 보여주는 유용한 지표”라며 “여행객들은 미처 가보지 못한 곳을 탐방하거나 새로운 경험을 시도하기 위해, 또는 단순히 좋아하는 여행지를 재방문하는 경향이 있다”고 설명했다. 올해 아시아 도시 재방문율 순위에서는 도쿄가 방콕을 제치고 1위를 차지했으며, 발리가 역대 최초로 3위에 이름을 올렸다. 그 다음으로는 서울과 오사카가 포함됐다. 다낭은 아시아 전체 6위로 쿠알라룸푸르, 후쿠오카, 타이베이, 조호르바루 등을 앞섰다. 베트남 도시 중에서는 다낭의 재방문객 비중이 가장 높게 나타났고, 뒤이어 호치민시, 냐짱(Nha Trang), 하노이, 푸꾸옥이 그 뒤를 이었다. 다낭의 순위는 전년보다 두 계단 상승했는데, 주로 긴 해변과 여유로운 분위기, 유네스코 세계문화유산인 호이안(Hoi An) 고도시로의 편리한 접근성이 순위 상승을 뒷받침했다. 이 밖에노 하노이와 호치민시 순위가 올랐는데, 특히 북부 산악도시인 사파(Sa Pa)는 3계단 약진했다. 올 들어 베트남을 찾는 외국인 관광객 증가세는 여행지 내 지출 확대로도 이어지고 있는데, 특히 △식음료 △편의점 △쇼핑 △엔터테인먼트 등 여행객의 실생활과 밀접한 서비스 분야에서 두드러진다. 이런 흐름은 비현금 결제 현황을 통해서도 확인된다. 결제 플랫폼 페이우(Payoo)에 따르면 지난 8월 29일부터 9월 6일까지 외국인 관광객의 QR코드·카드 결제 건수는 전년 동기 대비 50% 늘었으며, 주로 식음료 매장과 편의점에서 결제가 이뤄졌다.
